faq_heading: 2 bedroom condos in Cloverdale: your questions answered

faq.q: What do 2 bedroom condos sell for in Cloverdale?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom condos in Cloverdale, 75 sold over the past year at a median of $525,000, with the middle half between $473,500 and $605,000.

faq.q: How fast do 2 bedroom condos sell in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The median was 23 days, and homes sold for 96.7% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Where in Cloverdale do most 2 bedroom condos sell?
faq.a: Clayton, with 39 of the 75 sales at a median of $525,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in Cloverdale have 2 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Waterstone (11 sales, median $610,000); St. Andrews (9 sales, median $765,000); The Ridge at Bose Farms (5 sales, median $580,000); Esprit (4 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom condo in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom condos that sold in Cloverdale was $463 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom condos in Cloverdale compare
A 2 bedroom condo in Cloverdale sold for $125,550 more at the median than a 1 bedroom one ($525,000 against $399,450, 50 sales). The strata fee was $463 a month against $347.
Of the 9 cities with 2 bedroom condo pages, Cloverdale has the 6th highest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $383,000 and Tsawwassen highest at $614,000.
